fields.title: Brewmatic Pro 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker with Thermal Carafe

main_text:
Brewmatic Pro 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker with Thermal Carafe
Brews up to 12 cups and keeps coffee hot for four hours in a double-walled stainless steel carafe.
Programmable 24-hour timer so your coffee is ready when you wake up.
Adjustable brew strength with a bold setting for richer flavor.
Brand Brewmatic
Model BMP-12T
Capacity 1.8 Litres
